div.p: An optional attribute of agent that indicates the type of agent relevant in a specific context.
Use agentType in agent to specify the type of agent responsible for the creation, modification, or deletion of an EAS instance, when used within maintenanceEvent.

Use agentType in agent to specify the type of agent responsible for the creation, modification, or deletion of an EAS instance, when used within maintenanceEvent, or the type of agent relevant in the context of a narrativeEvent.

Use agentType in agent to specify the type of agent responsible for the creation, modification, or deletion of an EAS instance, when used within maintenanceEvent, the type of agent relevant in the context of a narrativeEvent or the type of agent important in relation to the creation, modification, publication, or use of record resources (within archDesc and the component elements) and of finding aids (within findAidDesc).
Use the attribute agentTypeEncoding in control to identify the list of authoritative terms that can be used as values of agentType.
